title: Bekhorot 4
description: How the priests and Levites came to be exempt from the firstborn: Abaye and Rava on the mishna’s a fortiori inference, Rav Safra’s challenges, how one Levite lamb redeemed many Israelite donkeys, and whether the firstborn born in the wilderness were sanctified.
topics: 🐑 Who exempted whom in the wilderness: the Levites for the firstborn sons, their sheep for the firstborn donkeys
⚖️ Abaye and Rava: does the a fortiori inference exempt the Levites’ animals, or the Levites themselves?
❓ Rav Safra’s challenges: the Levite with no lamb, the infant under a month, the Levite woman’s son, and Aaron
📜 “The priests the Levites”: twenty-four places where priests are called Levites
🪙 Silver and a lamb: how the redemption in the wilderness was done
🔢 One lamb for many donkeys: behemat in the singular against behemtam in the plural
🏜️ Rabbi Yoḥanan and Reish Lakish: were the firstborn born in the wilderness sanctified?
⛺ The day the Tabernacle was set up, and Rav Pappa’s proof from the census of the firstborn
